en.name: Simply360 Reference Files for Google Drive
en.summary: Move explicitly selected files between Simply360 and Google Drive.
en.description: A public-boundary reference app for FILE_SOURCE and FILE_DESTINATION. It requests only drive.file, never turns personal Drive into primary storage, and keeps each installation isolated.
highlights: Explicit Google Picker file and folder selection
Change notifications, reconciliation, revocation, and uninstall

alt.en: Interlocking Simply360 and file shapes for the Google Drive reference app
